Kapsch TrafficCom selects TomTom Traffic to enhance its global traffic management solutions

March 12, 2026 TomTom Newsroom Kapsch TrafficCom, TomTom Traffic, intelligent mobility, traffic management, EcoTrafiX, floating car data, smart cities
Read the source article

Quick summary

TomTom's official press release announces Kapsch TrafficCom's selection of TomTom Traffic to power next-generation intelligent mobility solutions for global traffic management.

Key takeaways

  • Kapsch TrafficCom selected TomTom Traffic to power its next-generation intelligent mobility offerings
  • The partnership enhances Kapsch's global traffic management solutions with TomTom's data capabilities
  • TomTom Traffic's floating car data provides real-time insights without requiring additional infrastructure
  • The collaboration supports cities and road authorities worldwide in making smarter mobility decisions
  • The announcement marks TomTom's continued expansion in the enterprise traffic management sector
